Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

actisomni (development version)

  • acti_asleep() and py_acti_asleep() now return times in the input’s time zone. asleep reports local clock times without a time zone, which were previously labelled UTC, shifting predictions by the UTC offset of the input (e.g. one hour for British Summer Time). A new tz argument sets the time zone, which is needed for file-path input (default "UTC").
  • For data-frame input, acti_asleep() and py_acti_asleep() pass asleep a clock held at the UTC offset at the start of the recording, so the clock never repeats or skips an hour at a daylight-saving transition and the returned times are the exact input instants. File input still reads the device clock in tz, so the two can differ after a transition.
  • acti_sleep_hdcza() now defaults to GGIR’s data-driven threshold: 15 times the 10th percentile of the five-minute rolling median absolute angle change, limited to 0.13–0.5 degrees. The percentile and multiplier are set with the new threshold_percentile and threshold_multiplier arguments (GGIR’s HDCZA_threshold = c(10, 15)). threshold now defaults to NULL; set it to a number for a fixed threshold, e.g. threshold = 0.2 for the previous default.
  • The HDCZA rolling statistic is now the median absolute angle change within each five-minute window of angles, as in GGIR, rather than the median of the changes over a window one epoch wider.

actisomni 0.2.0

CRAN release: 2026-10-16

  • Removed the Tudor–Locke sleep-period adapter and diary-labeling helper; these are now provided through actimetrics.
  • Removed actigraph.sleepr from Imports; actisomni no longer calls it.
  • Trying to cleanup uv lock.
  • Upgraded R version for pipe.
